name: open-symbols-search
title: Open Symbols Search
description: Search ~30,000 open-source icons via Open Symbols, and copy or export them as PNG, SVG, PDF or SF Symbol templates.
author: idiux

commands.name: search-open-symbols
commands.title: Search Open Symbols
commands.subtitle: Open Symbols
commands.description: Search Open Symbols across Lucide, Tabler, Phosphor, Material Design Icons and more.

commands.name: check-for-updates
commands.title: Check for Symbol Updates
commands.subtitle: Open Symbols
commands.description: Check for a newer Open Symbols release and update the symbol list if any symbols changed.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What happens when you press Return on a symbol.

preferences.name: gridSize
preferences.title: Grid Size
preferences.description: Default tile size. You can also change it from the action panel.

preferences.name: showNames
preferences.title: Display
preferences.label: Show Symbol Names
preferences.description: Show the symbol name under each tile.

preferences.name: showRecents
preferences.label: Show Recently Used Symbols
preferences.description: Show a Recently Used section above the results.

preferences.name: exportSize
preferences.title: Export Size
preferences.description: Pixels for PNG, points for PDF and SVG. Used by Export Symbol and Copy Image.

preferences.name: exportWeight
preferences.title: Export Weight
preferences.description: The weight of exported files and copied images.

preferences.name: exportColor
preferences.title: Export Color
preferences.description: A color name such as blue or gray, a #RRGGBB hex value, or currentColor (SVG only; inherits the CSS text color).

preferences.name: exportFrame
preferences.title: Export Frame
preferences.description: Square keeps the source library's canvas and padding, so icons line up at the same size. Tight crops to the symbol's edges.

preferences.name: formatSvg
preferences.label: SVG
preferences.description: Vector, at the chosen weight and color.

preferences.name: formatPdf
preferences.label: PDF
preferences.description: Vector, at the chosen size, weight and color.

preferences.name: formatTemplate
preferences.label: Custom Symbol Template
preferences.description: The editable template with every weight, for Xcode asset catalogs.

preferences.name: autoCheckUpdates
preferences.title: Symbol Updates
preferences.label: Check for new symbols weekly
preferences.description: When you open Search Open Symbols, check at most once a week for a newer Open Symbols release and offer to update.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
